scan.message_count_caveat: Session metadata uses the first session_meta record for current thread ID and cwd. User-role rows are counted across files without deduplication, including inherited/copied parent messages and environment/import records; they are not unique human business statements.

session_message_filtering: The first JSONL session_meta record in each rollout file supplies the current thread ID via payload.id and cwd; payload.session_id may refer to the parent thread.
Role counts include all role=user messages in each file, including inherited/copied parent messages; counts are not deduplicated across files.
Specific keyword line refs are locators only; original message bodies are omitted.

Exclude imported environment metadata, codex_internal_context, question-reply wrappers, transferred agent/reviewer history, transcript excerpts, assistant drafts, and numbered tool-call transcript items from firsthand-feedback candidate hits.

Specific hit locators use colleague/company-user/team-distribution wording; generic terms such as user, team, feedback, or adopt are listed as searched terms but are not counted as specific evidence hits.
